glosses: to ruin
to waste, to ruin, to destroy

examples.text: загуби́ть чью́-либо жизнь
examples.translation: to ruin someone's life; make someone's life a misery
examples.english: to ruin someone's life; make someone's life a misery

glosses: разг. привести к гибели, смерти; погубить
перен., разг. истратить, израсходовать понапрасну, без видимой пользы
перен., разг. испортить что-либо, нанести непоправимый вред, не дать развиться чему-либо
The remains of a destroyed or dilapidated construction, such as a house or castle.

examples.text: The Veian and the Gabian towirs shall fall, / And one promiscuous ruin cover all; / Nor, after length of years, a stone betray / The place where once the very ruins lay.
The labour of a day will not build up a virtuous habit on the ruins of an old and vicious character.

A canister of flour from the kitchen had been thrown at the looking-glass and lay like trampled snow over the remains of a decent blue suit with the lining ripped out which lay on top of the ruin of a plastic wardrobe.
Dr. Manuel: No one is saved. The age of humanity is ended. Soon, only ruin and corpses will remain.
Not only is Jerusalem not a ruin, but she is at the height of her glory compared to all of Jewish history!

glosses: The state of being a ruin, destroyed or decayed.

examples.text: The monastery has fallen into ruin.

glosses: Something that leads to serious trouble or destruction.

examples.text: Gambling has been the ruin of many.
The errors of young men are the ruin of business.

The Bat—they called him the Bat.[…]. He[…]played a lone hand,[…]. Most lone wolves had a moll at any rate—women were their ruin—but if the Bat had a moll, not even the grapevine telegraph could locate her.

glosses: The act of ruining something.
A fall or tumble.

examples.text: His ruin startled th’ other steeds.

glosses: A change that destroys or defeats something; destruction; overthrow.

examples.text: the ruin of a ship or an army
the ruin of a constitution or a government
the ruin of health or hopes

Oh Portius, is there not some choſen Curſe,
Some hidden Thunder in the Stores of Heav’n,
Red with uncommon Wrath, to blaſt the Man
Who owes his Greatneſs to his Country’s Ruin?
Ruin seize thee, ruthless king!

glosses: Complete financial loss; bankruptcy.
To cause the fiscal ruin of; to bankrupt or drive out of business.

examples.text: With all these purchases, you surely mean to ruin us!
In one way, indeed, he bade fair to ruin us; for he kept on staying week after week, and at last month after month, so that all the money had been long exhausted...

glosses: To destroy or render something no longer usable or operable.

examples.text: He ruined his new white slacks by accidentally spilling oil on them.
By the fireside there are old men seated, / Seeing ruined cities in the ashes.

glosses: To upset or overturn the plans or progress of, or to have a disastrous effect on something.

examples.text: My car breaking down just as I was on the road ruined my vacation.

glosses: To make something less enjoyable or likeable.

examples.text: I used to love that song, but being assaulted when that song was playing ruined the song for me.

glosses: To reveal the ending of (a story); to spoil.
To fall into a state of decay.

examples.text: Though he his house of polisht marble build, / Yet shall it ruine like the Moth's fraile cell

glosses: To seduce or debauch, and thus harm the social standing of.

examples.text: The young libertine was notorious for ruining local girls.

glosses: rendere qualcosa usurato prima del tempo
causare danni

examples.text: In questa scuola quell'insegnante ha rovinato una generazione scolastica intera

glosses: agire scorrettamente nel lavoro
lasciare con debiti e gravi problemi interiori

examples.text: il gioco d'azzardo lo aveva rovinato

glosses: etwas erfolglos, sinnlos, planlos, unrationell aufwenden

examples.text: Warum habe ich meine Zeit vergeudet?
Vergeudest du wieder das ganze Geld für Tand?
Marko hat in diesem Monat 50 Euro gespart, weil er sein Taschengeld dieses Mal nicht für Computerspiele vergeudet hat.

Nach meiner Einschätzung werden viel zu viele junge Leute mit zu hohem Anspruch ausgebildet, mehr, als die Gesellschaft braucht, und weit mehr, als dazu überhaupt begabt sind. Da wird ein unglaubliches Potenzial an Ausbildungskraft vergeudet.

translations.source_sense_description: испортить что-либо, нанести непоправимый вред чему-либо

glosses: To break or spoil something, or make it inoperative, useless etc.

examples.text: I've buggered up the sudoku somehow and can't finish it.

Well, he only buggers up one sentence, and that's the first one. He says, 'Shut up, blek.' But from that point on, it was OK because I helped him with it. If I'd been there, I would have told him to say, 'Shut up, black', exactly the same as an American accent.

glosses: To injure or harm (someone).

translations.source_sense_description: испортить что-либо, нанести непоправимый вред чему-либо

glosses: Causar destrucción y ruina.

examples.text: El terremoto de Chillán en 1939 arruinó la ciudad que hubo que reconstruir en otro emplazamiento, y ostenta el triste récord de víctimas fatales en la historia de los terremotos de Chile: 24.000.
De aquí que cuando en 1846 se produjo una plaga que arruinó la cosecha de patata, la mayor parte de la población rural se quedo sin alimentos.

glosses: Causar un desastre económico a personas, empresas o países.
tags: se usa también como verbo pronominal

examples.text: La bajada masiva del valor de las acciones arruinó a muchísimos inversores, cerró empresas y bancos, condenó al paro a millones de personas y, debido al efecto dominó, trasladó el mismo problema a muchas naciones.
Como resultado de la crisis económica subsecuente, un amplio segmento de la clase media se arruinó, el comercio fue monopolizado por judios alemanes.

glosses: Causarle un daño muy grande a algo material o inmaterial.

examples.text: Aquella excursión le arruinó y fue el factor desencadenante que contribuyó también a arruinar su salud.

glosses: Dicho de una persona, causarle un grave daño moral.

translations.source_sense_description: испортить что-либо, нанести непоправимый вред чему-либо

glosses: Volver algo a su estado original.
Disolver algo sólido en un líquido.
